## Summary

One or two sentences: what this is and why it matters.

## Context

Background needed to understand why this exists, without requiring the reader to
have been part of the conversation where it came up. If this originated from a
review, a known limitation, or a decision made elsewhere, say so and point at it
(commit, PR, other issue).

## Scope

What's explicitly in scope for this task.

## Out of scope

What this task deliberately does *not* cover. Keeps the task from creeping, and
signals what belongs in a separate task instead.

## Acceptance criteria

Concrete, checkable conditions for "this is done" — specific enough that
completion isn't a judgment call.

- [ ]
- [ ]

## Open questions / notes

Anything still undecided, tradeoffs being made, assumptions that need verifying,
or things to flag before or during implementation. Delete this section if there's
genuinely nothing open.
